cohort: The study included 43,822 pregnant women who underwent GBS screening and delivered between 2016 and 2018 in Xiamen, China.
finding: Pregnant women with diabetes mellitus are at high risk of GBS infection, and intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis (IAP) is highly effective in preventing adverse pregnancy and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Modes of delivery were not significantly different between GBS-positive and GBS-negative groups.
